theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Technology (+0.74%) and Financials (+0.68%) led the market today, while Utilities (-0.79%) and Real Estate (-0.78%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.01%, defensives -0.36%, and value/cyclicals +0.18% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.27%, Dow +0.17%, Nasdaq +0.28% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.41%. The VIX fell 3.43% to 16.91, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold slipped 0.04% to $4,054.80, crude oil was little changed at $102.17, and bitcoin slipped 0.01% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
